standard_prerequisites.name: Nakayama's lemma
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked twice inside the counted proof (source lines 666-668 and 669-671) as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes the chosen map surjective and shows that proper submodules do not map onto the target.

core_obligations: Choose generators: take elements of the module mapping to a basis of the quotient by the maximal ideal and form the corresponding map from a finite free module (proof lines 664-667)
Surjectivity: the map is surjective by Nakayama's lemma (proof lines 667-668)
Essentialness: for a proper submodule the induced map between the quotients by the maximal ideal is not surjective by Nakayama's lemma again, so the surjection is essential (proof lines 669-672)
proof_roadmap: 令 r = dim_κ(M/mM)，取 x_1,…,x_r 使其像为 M/mM 的基，作 f : R^{⊕r} → M。
由 Nakayama 引理 f 满。
若 N ⊂ R^{⊕r} 是真子模，再由 Nakayama 得 N/mN → κ^{⊕r} 不满，从而 N/mN → M/mM 不满 ⇒ f 是本质满射。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a finite module over a local ring admits a projective cover (author lemma at source lines 658-662, label lemma-projective-covers-local). The proof (source lines 664-673) chooses a minimal set of generators, uses Nakayama's lemma for surjectivity and again to show that no proper submodule maps onto the target, which is essentialness (proof lines 664-672). The double use of Nakayama is the substance. H3.
